notes:
v1.0.88 - Big update: Discord status, Servers, i18n, Screenshots, custom installer & more
1) DISCORD RICH PRESENCE: your status shows what you are doing in Reimagined (browsing, or playing with a live timer + profile/version) using the Reimagined logo. Toggle in Settings, ON by default, fails silently if Discord is closed.
2) SERVERS (Games > Servers): favorites with live ping / player count / MOTD, recently played, and Join that launches the selected profile straight into the server.
3) SCREENSHOTS (Instances > Screenshots): grid of that instance F2 screenshots, lightbox with scroll zoom, export one/many, delete with confirmation.
4) MULTI-LANGUAGE: English (default), Spanish and French across the whole launcher via Account > Language, instant and persistent, English fallback for missing strings.
5) ACCOUNT UPGRADES: Accessibility (font scale, high contrast, colorblind-friendly statuses) and Statistics with a real playtime chart from your tracked playtime.
6) STREAMING AWARENESS: detects OBS/recording and suppresses non-critical toasts + pauses AFK throttling while you are being watched. Toggle in Settings.
7) NEW STARTUP SOUND: a premium system-activation sound designed to follow the logo animation, plays once, respects volume.
8) CUSTOM INSTALLER/UNINSTALLER: fully branded Reimagined setup wizard (splash intro, explained steps, real progress, Launch on finish). The uninstaller offers Remove application only (keeps your data - safe default) or Remove everything (extra confirmation, thorough cleanup incl. registry + scheduled tasks) and refuses to run while the app/game is open.
